name: Spin
description: The first clip spins out shrinking, then the second spins in growing, with motion blur. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: turns
params.description: Turns made by each clip during its half of the transition, rounded to the nearest half turn (below 0.25 rounds to 0: no spin)

params.name: zoom
params.description: How much the clips shrink at the middle: 1 = to nothing, 0 = not at all

params.name: blur
params.description: Motion-blur samples along the rotation (1 = no blur)
